description: This dataset compiles human observations of the planthopper species Ormenaria rufifascia, primarily recorded in Florida and South Carolina between 2019 and 2026. Each record includes detailed taxonomic classification, precise geolocation coordinates, and observation timestamps, facilitating spatial and temporal analysis of the species' distribution. The data, sourced from iNaturalist, features identifiers for both the observation and the taxon, along with information on the observers and licensing terms. Researchers can utilize this collection to study population trends, habitat preferences, and the ecological presence of Ormenaria rufifascia in the southeastern United States, supported by associated media such as still images.
